chapter_title: Foundations of CBI and Design Tensions
title: Module 1 Reflection Studio
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting module 1 reflection studio to Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Distinguish a synthesis reflection (names a sourced principle, shows a revised belief, transfers to a new dilemma, leaves an honest open tension) from a vague recap.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Transfer a module principle to a classroom dilemma the module never used.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible.
